== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Zakariel]], also known as the Fox, is a white, five-tailed entity who possesses significant knowledge regarding the secrets of [[Monarchs]]. She is characterized as a selfish individual who prioritizes her own interests, often acting to secure valuables for herself during conflicts. [[Zakariel]] is capable of high speeds and has been identified as a unique asset able to bypass specific cordons to move between locations like Fathom and [[Haven]]. In certain contexts, she has been seen acting as a predator that can quickly secure prey. Beyond the individual entity, "Fox" refers to a specific division or path of techniques. These methods involve [[binding]] [[Way|the Way]] to create portals, which facilitates travel between and within different [[Iterations]]. The Fox path is associated with various specialized abilities, such as the [[Fox Mirror]] for invisibility and illusion, the [[Foxtail]] technique to make movements difficult to track, and the [[Fox Dream]]. These techniques often utilize [[White Fox|White Fox madra]] to create illusions, shields, or mental manipulations.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The Fox possesses the high skill required to travel between [[Iterations]]. This individual is capable of opening portals and is the only person able to breach the cordon around Fathom and return to [[Haven]] undetected.}}
